REAL thread via production UI: typing into #task-input + clicking #run-task (the composer's production path) runs the demo provider → a thread appears → clicking the sidebar thread opens the surface → a DENSE elementFromPoint grid + a real pointer toggle work with the thread overlay open (no forced hidden)

kvSet reports durable vs session mode (unit-tested); the durable write path + the backend-failure reject are unit-tested
RTL nub centres on the rail's inner (left) boundary + swaps the border to the inner edge
rapid double-click returns to the deterministic prior state; the ViewTransition.finished is awaited via a TEST-INJECTED patch of document.startViewTransition (never shipped)

limitations: A storage-GRANTED durable round-trip across a SERVICE-WORKER restart is NOT exercised by the integration harness: the optional storage permission requires a headed owner gesture (chrome.permissions.request) that a headless profile cannot grant. The durable WRITE path itself is unit-tested (kvSet returns 'durable' when the backend is present + healthy, and throws StorageBackendError when the backend write fails).

Only default light/LTR collapsed and expanded screenshots are retained; the real open-thread overlay, RTL, dark, narrow, reduced-motion, and focus states are asserted programmatically (computed style / elementFromPoint / transition), not captured as separate PNGs.
